title: Nonzero probability and Hamming norm
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$. The uniform probability that $f$ is nonzero equals its Hamming norm divided by the size of the domain: $\Pr(f\ne0)=\frac{\|f\|_0}{2^n}$, where $\|f\|_0$ is the number of inputs on which $f$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the binary cube of dimension $n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
